verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships an official MCP server that hands an AI agent the full collection/request/environment reference and lets it actually execute the requests (real HTTP calls), which matches an AI-native user exploring an interactive API reference with runnable examples; this is reinforced by the CLI and the web/desktop clients' request-building, response-handling, and code-snippet generation features. Missing for 10: a dedicated auto-generated, publicly browsable API reference/doc page (Swagger-UI-like) beyond the Embed widget, and independent hands-on validation that the MCP-server-driven 'reference' experience works smoothly in practice.
